versions.content: When a call to an Rte_Rips_<Plugin>_NotifyTpTxConfir- mation API exists within an Rte_LdComCbkTpTxConfirmation callback, the RTE shall pass through the following IN parameters from the outer callback function context as parameters to the Rte_Rips_<Plugin>_NotifyTpTxConfirmation call: • result The variables passed to the Rte_Rips_<Plugin>_NotifyTpTxConfirmation shall be unchanged from the parameters passed to the Rte_LdComCbkTpTxCon- firmation callback.
